Push Pointer MachineHydraulic pointing unit with integrated power pack & control cabinet
Push
Pointing Machine
Our Push Pointer Machines are engineered for heavy-duty end pointing of rods, tubes, pipes, and solid cylindrical components. With proven hydraulic designs ranging from 35 Tons to 350 Tons capacity, the system delivers controlled and uniform diameter reduction for downstream processing. The rigid frame construction ensures stability under high loads, making it suitable for demanding industrial environments. Designed for precision, durability, and consistent performance.

Key Features
  • Hydraulically operated — far superior ease of pointing vs conventional swaging/squeeze
  • Three Stage Die Indexing system for small diameter thick wall tubes
  • Supplied with suitable handling system for smooth material flow
  • Load sensing hydraulic pump for low power consumption
  • Regenerative hydraulic circuits for faster cycle time
  • Optional: IIoT features, auto/semi-auto handling, online lubrication system
3-Stage Die Indexing System
Indexed dies, hydraulic force, low power draw
  • Three indexed die stations progressively reduce tube-end diameter in a single automated cycle
  • A hydraulic cylinder drives the point rod through each die stage with precise, repeatable force control
  • Load-sensing hydraulic pump delivers power only as needed, cutting energy consumption
  • Cable-carrier-managed hydraulic & electrical lines keep the moving carriage tidy and easy to service

Best Paired With: Draw Bench. The Push Pointing Machine is the essential pre-operation step before cold drawing. Customers who have a Draw Bench almost always need this machine — pitch them together for maximum conversion.
